findings.title: Dashboard 'Recent waterings' shows 'No waterings yet' when the API returns a non-list
findings.expected: An unexpected response shows an error, not the empty state
findings.actual: With an {} response the section says 'No waterings yet. Use Water now on a bed to record one.' even though waterings exist

findings.title: Bed filter on Waterings page is lost on reload: page writes ?bed_id= to the URL but only reads ?bed=
findings.expected: After choosing a bed, reloading or sharing the URL (/waterings?bed_id=1) keeps the bed filter and shows only that bed's waterings
findings.actual: URL becomes /waterings?bed_id=1, but after reload the select shows 'All beds' and every bed's waterings are listed (2 waterings, 14 L) while the URL still says bed_id=1
findings.evidence: {"url":"/waterings?bed_id=1","select":"","text":["Waterings","Waterings","2 waterings, 14 L in total","Watering log","Waterings, most recent first","watering of Shade corner","watering of North bed"]} | {"url":"/waterings?bed_id=1","select":"","text":["Waterings","Waterings","2 waterings, 14 L in total","Watering log","Waterings, most recent first","watering of Shade corner","watering of North bed"]}

findings.title: Past watering form accepts 0.001 L and reports 'Recorded 0 L'
findings.expected: Amounts below the input's min of 0.1 L are refused, or the saved amount is shown truthfully
findings.actual: 0.001 is saved (litres 0.001) and the success message and list both show '0 L'
findings.evidence: {"alerts":["Recorded 0 L on 2 Nov 2026."],"created":[{"id":3,"bed_id":2,"bed_name":"Shade corner","watered_on":"2026-11-02","watered_at":null,"litres":0.001}]} | {"alerts":["Recorded 0 L on 2 Nov 2026."],"created":[{"id":3,"bed_id":2,"bed_name":"Shade corner","watered_on":"2026-11-02","watered_at":null,"litres":0.001}]}

findings.title: Past watering form accepts the year 1 as a date
findings.expected: An implausible date such as 0001-01-01 is refused with a reason
findings.actual: Saved and confirmed as 'Recorded 5 L on 1 Jan 1.'; it then appears in the watering log and totals
findings.evidence: {"alerts":["Recorded 5 L on 1 Jan 1."],"created":[{"id":3,"bed_id":2,"bed_name":"Shade corner","watered_on":"0001-01-01","watered_at":null,"litres":5}]} | {"alerts":["Recorded 5 L on 1 Jan 1."],"created":[{"id":3,"bed_id":2,"bed_name":"Shade corner","watered_on":"0001-01-01","watered_at":null,"litres":5}]}
